naming.text: The open naming tasks cover six approval arms, the fold-created record and removal of the claim lifecycle.

Retirement must prove the recovery key or quorum, co-mint approval and create the request at the immutable same-registry request-validator identity while leaving the leaf active. Completion must consume that actual request through Contribute with state Modify and custody before writing terminal.

Wrong validator, wrong token, missing approval and mismatched approval need executable refusals and positive controls. No cage RequestDatum arm is added. Remaining tasks preserve destination value, rerun Maintain and Recover, remove the old vocabulary and regenerate both script identities.

consumers-and-docs.text: Conformance must state the contract change and derive and verify cage and token, then request validator, then naming application and policy. Update the naming pages and their speech, pass presentation checks, and provide a total Aiken-trace to Lean-reason table.
